name: Flock Hunt
storyline: Your town bought cameras. Lots of them. They record everyone, all the time, whether or not you've done anything. One of them photographed you. Now you're in the file, and the only way out is to take the whole network down, one pole at a time.
summary: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.
